messages:
Iris Nakamura: FYI opened PR to update the region availability matrix and to add localized labels (es, fr, ja). Also fixing two broken links to legacy support articles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4078
DocsBot: PR opened by Iris Nakamura: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4078 (build queued)
Diego Alvarez: Thanks Iris. I'll take the Node + Python SDK snippets and ensure they show the new 'region' client option and the Accept-Language header example. We should show both, since a few customers use the header directly.
Iris Nakamura: Yes please. Also the matrix needs to show 'Partial' for APAC embeddings until the quantized model rollout completes. Put a note linking to the rollout tracker.
Priya Singh: Quick question: for localized labels, do we pluralize "Regions" per locale? Example: 'Régions' vs 'Région' — I'd prefer to follow the existing i18n keys but double-check.
Tom Lee: i18n note: follow the UI string keys in /i18n/en.json. If the translation is ambiguous, flag for legal/marketing review.
Diego Alvarez: Draft snippet for Node in the PR comment: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'eu-west', language: 'fr-CA' });
// or raw header example
await fetch('/api/endpoint', { headers: { 'Accept-Language': 'fr-CA', 'X-Region-Preference': 'eu-west' }});
```
Iris Nakamura: Nice. For the Python example include requests and show how to map client config to headers.
Diego Alvarez: Will do. Also adding a short note: "Changing the docs region label only affects which docs landing page you see; it does not change where account data is stored. See /legal/data-residency for details."
Priya Singh: We should also add a tiny troubleshooting section: "If you see unexpected English text, try clearing cache or use ?locale=xx in the URL to force language."
Iris Nakamura: Good call. Add that and a short line about CDN propagation delays when we update region labels.
Tom Lee: FYI the old support article /support/regions-deprecated-2019 has redirected but the anchor links are broken. I suggest replacing the link with the canonical /docs/regions-legacy and updating anchors.
Iris Nakamura: I replaced both links and added a redirect note in the migration guide. I also included translators' TODO comments for es and ja keys.
DocsBot: CI passed for PR #4078
Priya Singh: Quick review done. Left two small nits on phrasing and a request to add a screenshot for the matrix accessibility check.
Diego Alvarez: Addressed nits and uploaded accessibility screenshot. Also made the Python snippet show both client param and headers: ```python
# client config
client = RedwoodClient(region='ap-southeast', language='zh-Hans')
# raw request
resp = requests.get('https://docs.redwood.ai/api', headers={ 'Accept-Language': 'zh-Hans', 'region': 'ap-southeast' })
```
Iris Nakamura: Great. Can someone run staging smoke test for the localized matrix and snippets? Ping me in #eng-oncall if anything flakier than expected.
Tom Lee: I'll run it. Testing now against staging.
Tom Lee: Staging checks: matrix renders in es and fr, screenshot accessibility passes, redirects fixed \u2705. Found minor spacing issue in ja label, pushing a one-line fix.
Iris Nakamura: Thanks all. Once the tiny fix merges, I'll add a changelog entry under docs/changelog and schedule the rollout for Tuesday docs release. Closing thread after merge.
DocsBot: PR #4078 merged by Iris Nakamura at 2392020420 (build succeeded)
Iris Nakamura: Merged and changelog entry added. Closing thread."
